categories.main_business_segments: Bohae Brewery Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the manufacturing and sales of alcoholic beverages including soju, fruit wine, liqueurs, makgeolli (traditional rice wine), distilled spirits, whiskey, and also in the production and sales of food and beverages. The company is organized as a single business unit focusing on alcoholic beverages and food products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses traditional and modern brewing and distillation techniques, including patented natural sweetener blending and low-temperature pasteurization methods for makgeolli. It employs advanced production lines with specific capacities for soju, fruit wines, and beverages, and has implemented quality management systems such as ISO 9001 and HACCP certifications. Research and development focus on premium product development, blending techniques, and innovative recipes like salt-based soju and highball whiskey blends.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Bohae serves both domestic and international markets, targeting general consumers of alcoholic beverages, including home-use and entertainment sectors. Key customers include retail consumers, convenience stores, large franchises, and export markets such as Japan, Southeast Asia, and the US. The company also supplies OEM and ODM products to major corporations and specialty trade partners.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with a strong regional base in Gwangju and Jeonnam provinces. It also exports products to global markets including Japan, Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Singapore, Malaysia, Cambodia), and the US. Domestic sales cover nationwide distribution through various retail and wholesale channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bohae operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and distributor of alcoholic beverages and food products. It sources raw materials such as distilled spirits and fruits from contracted farms and suppliers, processes and packages finished products, and distributes them through retail and export channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes product innovation aligned with changing consumer trends such as low-alcohol and health-conscious beverages. R&D focuses on premiumization, new product development including blended whiskey and fruit-based highballs, and expanding ODM/OEM capabilities. Strategic priorities include enhancing product line specialization, niche market targeting, and global brand development through content and marketing campaigns.
categories.revenue_model: Bohae generates revenue primarily through the sale of alcoholic beverages and food products both domestically and internationally. Revenue streams include direct product sales to retailers and consumers, OEM/ODM manufacturing contracts, and rental income from property. Export sales and branded product licensing also contribute to revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly competitive domestic alcoholic beverage market with multiple soju manufacturers and other liquor producers. While it holds a niche with strong fruit wine brands like Bohae Bokbunja and Maechwisun, it faces competition from larger players such as Jinro and HiteJinro. Bohae positions itself as a premium and innovative brand with a focus on regional identity and export growth.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Bohae reported consolidated revenues of approximately 930 billion KRW, with a slight increase from the previous year. The company experienced an operating loss due to increased raw material costs and provisions for bad debts but maintains a solid asset base of about 1.43 trillion KRW and equity of around 800 billion KRW. The company shows stable but modest growth with ongoing investments in production capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bohae differentiates itself through premium product quality using natural ingredients like pure mountain spring water and locally sourced fruits, innovative recipes such as salt-infused soju, and a strong heritage brand identity. It emphasizes health-conscious and trend-responsive products, niche market targeting, and sustainability initiatives like ESG campaigns. The company also leverages collaborations and global marketing to enhance brand recognition and consumer loyalty.
